title: Been working on an airline management game, would like some feedback on how it looks
author: TheBlackDragon670
selftext:
Here’s a 30 second clip of the airline sim I’ve been making in Unity. You start with one small plane at an airstrip doing mail and village runs, and work up to commuter routes, hubs, and eventually jets. Claude Code has written pretty much all of the code, I’ve mostly been deciding how the game should look and play.



The clip shows the start of a bush airline, the cabin view (you can zoom into any plane and see who’s on board), and then a quick run through most of the menus.



I’m mainly after feedback on the UI and visuals. I went for a paper/document style for the menus instead of the usual dark dashboard look, but I’m not sure if it works or just looks plain. Also curious whether the globe, clouds and cabin view look good or if anything looks off.



Still a lot to polish, so any criticism is welcome.
